posts.hook: Supplier inquiries are not a communication problem. They are a process-design problem.
posts.key_stat: AP teams outside the Best-in-Class spend 26.9% of staff time on supplier inquiries. Best-in-Class spend 13.4%.
posts.source: Ardent Partners, AP Metrics that Matter 2025
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card leading with 26.9% of AP staff time, contrasted against the 13.4% Best-in-Class benchmark, framing supplier self-service as the operating-model difference.
